ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-3
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District, symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 8-H in the area bound by:

      West 35th Street; a line 97 feet east of and parallel to South Paulina Street; the alley next
      south of and parallel to West 35th Street; and a line 49 feet east of and parallel to South
      Paulina Street,

to those of a B3-2, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                            ____________________________
                                                            Nicole T. Lee
                                                            Alderperson, 11th Ward




Common Address:
1653 W. 35th Street
